conventions.labels: 0..8 independently for X and Y; a matching is permutation pi of Y labels, with edge X[i] to Y[pi[i]]
conventions.cost: integer numerators of absolute coordinate differences, divided by 37
conventions.thresholds: nonnegative integer numerators maxX,maxY with inclusive comparisons; exact for every distinct threshold family on this input
conventions.rank: zero-based lexicographic order of complete permutation arrays; prefix condition fixes initial X rows
conventions.sampling: declared deterministic points, not random or i.i.d. uniform
conventions.source: Talagrand matching statement supplies context, not these coordinates or this finite method
